title: Harvey Field
text: Inyokern's airfield was dedicated as Harvey Field on May 10, 1944, in honor of Navy Lieutenant Commander Warren Harvey, for his work on aviation ordnance and fighter tactics. The Navy closed Harvey Field in April 1946 and returned it to the county a year later.

s1.title: Naval Auxiliary Air Facility Inyokern
